suite: CAP-SDK-003 — public Banzami Python SDK, published on PyPI outside every Banzami repository

registry.name: PyPI
registry.summary: Official Python SDK for the Banzami payments platform

assertions.note: PyPI /pypi/banzami-python/json returns 200 with latest=0.1.0 and both a py3-none-any wheel and an sdist
summary 'Official Python SDK for the Banzami payments platform'; project URLs point to banzami.com and github.com/banza-protocol/banzami — the package is Banzami's, not a name-squat
the bare 'banzami' name is NOT published (PyPI /pypi/banzami/json returns 404); the real, published package is 'banzami-python'

a py3.12+ clean-room `pip install banzami-python` + run was NOT executed here (this host's pip targets Python <3.12, which the package's Requires-Python >=3.12 excludes). Registry publication + wheel presence are proven; the run-and-consume assertion is a follow-up on a py3.12 environment.

note: Recorded so PUBLISHED_PACKAGES may carry a real `pip install banzami-python` command. The claim proven here is registry publication and package identity; a full py3.12 clean-room install-and-run is a follow-up.
